kioku: Glad it didn't go through. Gift‑card payments are a classic scam vector — never send them to an unsolicited "support" caller. If the terminal really needs a certificate renewal, your regular payment processor or the card company's official channel will handle it. Let me know if you want me to note that in your records or look up the correct contact.
